subject: [hw] R1: V18 accepted (225740/225740, 23/23 independent forms)
body:
I reviewed DONE V18 rev 2 and ran:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V18 PASS 225740/225740, V18-IOS compile zero warnings, V18-VENDOR every class mnemonic covered.
My 23 independent NEON 3-same forms also pass against the current tree: vadd.i32/i8, vsub.i16, vand, veor, vbic, vbsl, vceq.i32, vcgt.s16, vmax.u8, vmin.s32, vhadd.u16, vqadd.s8 (QC), vmul.i32, vmla.i32, vabd.s8, vrhadd.u16, vtst.32, vadd.f32, vceq.f32, vmax.f32, vqdmulh.s32. The float path (FZ=1, DN=1, FE_TONEAREST restored, separate multiply/add for VMLA, double intermediate for VFMA) and the 64-bit saturation intermediates match the Arm pseudocode as far as I can check; no finding. V18 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
